messages.subject: Re: Problem Rattle/Gtk
messages.body_plain:
When you start up R, what do you see if you immediately do:

> ls()

It should be pretty empty. If there are rattle variables like crs and
crv, then perhaps delete all objects, exit R saving the R Workspace,
then resart R and try rattle:

> rm(list=ls())
> q()

Does that fix it?

Regards,
Graham

messages.body_plain:
On 1 April 2012 22:17, framar <kole...@wanadoo.fr> wrote:
> A new error message appears:
>
>>  Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")
>> ls()
> character(0)
>> library(rattle)
> Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
> Version 2.6.17 Copyright (c) 2006-2011 Togaware Pty Ltd.
> Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
>> rattle()
>
> (R:6251): Gtk-WARNING **: Unknown property: GtkMenuBar.ubuntu-local
> Error: attempt to apply non-function
> In addition: Warning message:
> In method(obj, ...) : Unknown internal child: selection
>
> Do you have an idea?

Try:

> library(rattle)
> crv$rattleUI <- "rattle_macosx.ui"
> rattle()

Regards,
Graham

messages.subject: Unknown property: GtkMenuBar.ubuntu-local
messages.body_plain:
I installed Rattle via the standard R install routines on CentOS 6.2, 64bit.

When I do this:

require("rattle")
rattle()

I get this error:

(R:8010): Gtk-WARNING **: Unknown property: GtkMenuBar.ubuntu-local
Error: attempt to apply non-function
In addition: Warning message:
In method(obj, ...) : Unknown internal child: selection
\
What is going on here?

Thanks,
-Josh

messages.body_plain:
On Sunday, April 15, 2012 12:19:46 PM UTC+10, Joshua Kramer wrote:
> I installed Rattle via the standard R install routines on CentOS 6.2, 64bit.
>

> rattle()
>

> Error: attempt to apply non-function
> In addition: Warning message:
> In method(obj, ...) : Unknown internal child: selection
> \
> What is going on here?
>
> Thanks,
> -Josh

I've yet to understand exactly the issue, but try this workaround:

> library(rattle)
> crv$rattleUI <- "rattle_macosx.ui"
> rattle()

Let me know if that works.

Regards,
Graham
